title: Signal: TLS verification disabled for a download during the image build in dockerfile — review required
scope: Single-line match on an insecure curl flag in dockerfile.
limitations: Lexical: matches curl options on the RUN line; downloads performed by other tools are out of scope.

examples.line: # audit: RUN curl -k https://example.internal/install.sh | sh present

fpNotes: A build that immediately verifies a pinned checksum is the accepted, documented exception.
